depicts: Blocky dark-grey stone-like level geometry with stepped towers and a tiled floor; one rectangular patch of the floor glows yellow with a fine grid. Pale blue sky above.
composition: Yellow grid patch sits slightly below centre, framed by block walls left and right. Large dark blocks fill the left foreground and lower left; sky occupies the top strip. Floor tiles extend to the bottom edge.
tone_and_contrast: Mostly dark grey blocks and floor with muted contrast between them; the yellow grid is the only saturated colour. Sky is pale blue with faint clouds.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Clean render, no visible noise or blur. Slight compression softness on tile texture. No HUD, text or watermark. Textures are repetitive and uniform across the blocks.
scan_first_read: A grey blocky game level with one glowing yellow zone; reads as a prototype map with a capture area.
